name: "No Post-Task Progress Summary Files"
---
# No Post-Task Progress Summary Files

- Do not create progress summary markdown files after task completion.
- Prefer giving completion details directly in chat instead of writing new summary files.
- If a progress or handoff markdown file is explicitly requested, create it.
